children.game_version: A follow-the-leader chain game where children mimic the leader's tapping steps.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the arm-linking and rhythmic tapping while seated in a circle.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the steps in place without the criss-crossing movement.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and limited range of knee bending.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Participants hold on to each other; those at the end hold up with a single hand.
movement_profile.footwork: Slow and fast footwork, tapping, and criss-crossing.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Long line or semi-circles (men outer, women inner).
movement_profile.partnering: Participants hold onto each other in a line.

signature_moves.description: A rhythmic movement of the feet while moving across the space.
signature_moves.name: Criss-crossing

music_profile.sound_description: The music is a narrative folk song that tells tales of the past, often structured as a dialogue between a man and a woman.
music_profile.vocal_style: Narrative, conversational between a man and a woman.

basic_steps: Form a long line or semi-circle by holding onto the person next to you.
Execute slow and fast footwork including tapping.
Incorporate occasional knee bending in sync with the rhythm.
teaching.formation: Long line or semi-circles (men outer, women inner).
teaching.level_notes: Beginner-friendly, focusing on coordination and group synchronization.
teaching.rhythm: Syncopated with the narrative song rhythm.
